prBodyNotes: Upstream release: https://github.com/rabbitmq/cluster-operator/releases. Refresh `templates/` from the new `cluster-operator.yml` and bump `version`/`appVersion` in `Chart.yaml`, then cut a chart release tag matching the operator tag. Re-apply the `.Release.Namespace` / `.Release.Name` substitutions in `templates/`.

After bumping `appVersion`, run `./scripts/compare-upstream.sh` and use the diff to refresh `templates/cluster-operator/`. Preserve chart-specific Helm behavior (`.Release.Namespace` / `.Release.Name` substitutions). Leave CRD changes to `bacluc-agent/rabbitmq-crd-chart`.
